''See also: [[Esh’kinaar Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Esh’kinaar, known as the [[Swarm-Queen]] of the [[D’Niss]], is a massive psychic insectoid entity that poses a significant threat to the galaxy. Described as being larger than any other encountered [[D’Niss]], her presence is so immense that she can warp the orbits of planets within a star system. She has been known to linger in [[Dark Space]] and consume stars, though she has also appeared within the local dimension. Her arrival is characterized by a massive magical disruption that overwhelms the [[Aether]]. In combat, she utilizes diamond-shaped projections through a form of [[Combat Art]] and possesses the ability to use spawn magic, a biological conjuration used to create new [[D’Niss]]. While she has been defeated in the past, she remains a legendary figure that necessitates galactic defense. Her biology includes a carapace, and she has the capacity to produce offspring, such as a new [[Swarm-Queen]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|This star-eating psychic insect possesses a carapace that shimmers with the appearance of spilled oil and features black-diamond plates on her thorax. Her wings are composed of wispy rainbows, and she hovers slightly behind the local sun. Her gaze is described as being like weaponized [[Subspace]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|An accomplished spellcaster, Esh’kinaar can utilize spell cancellation to limit magic. She uses spawn magic, a form of conjuration, to produce new versions of the [[D’Niss]]. Additionally, she can consume [[World Spirits]] by breaking them down and converting them into new creatures.}}
